scope: held-out H01/H03 seeds 11/12/13 (six seeds), first three native source updates each
gate: fixed-trace A1 (MSF) vs A2 (CCDE-Wind) with per-seed frozen snapshot triplets

key_evidence.a2_vs_a1_ranks: 18 held-out updates: A2 candidate-rank delta vs A1 is 0 on 14 updates, +1 on 3 updates (H01_11 U2, H03_11 U2, H03_13 U2 medoid/cov), -1 on 1 update (H01_12 U0); no consistent added value
key_evidence.shuffled_control_interpretation: physical wind-moment association is not robustly better than 100 fixed candidate-shuffled assignments (H01 3/3 seeds worse; H03 2/3 seeds modestly better, 1/3 worse); discovery H03 signal (0.96) does not reproduce (held-out H03 mean ~0.64)
key_evidence.mechanism_controls: unit source response = 1.0 on all updates; wind-nuisance leakage <= 1.8e-12 (approx 0); CRN parity byte-identical; M1 fixed-support parity max_abs_diff = 0 on all 18 updates
key_evidence.h01_no_harm: no systematic degradation on H01 (A2 ~ A1 on map/medoid error, entropy, coverage)
key_evidence.h03_improvement: no material improvement of A2 over A1 on H03 (marginal rank deltas only)

verdict_reason: The candidate-conditioned wind-direction moment passes construction controls (unit response, leakage ~0, CRN, M1 parity) but fails the mechanism-specificity gate on held-out data: physical wind-nuisance association does not beat candidate-shuffled association on both houses in aggregate, and A2 does not robustly improve mechanism metrics over A1.
no_truth_tuning: held-out truths were used only after inference artifacts were frozen (INFERENCE_FROZEN.done markers); no discovery or held-out truth was used to select parameters.
